{{about|the buff|the support gem|Arcane Surge Support}}

'''Arcane Surge''' is a [[buff]] that grants bonus [[cast speed]] and [[mana regeneration]].

==Mechanics==
Arcane Surge lasts 4 seconds by default. Unless otherwise stated, Arcane Surge granted from [[equipment]], [[passive skills]], and [[Ascendancy passive skill]]s are identical to the buff granted by {{il|Arcane Surge Support}}:
* {{c|mod|20% increased Cast Speed}}
* {{c|mod|30% increased Mana Regeneration Rate}}

The buff does not stack. Gaining Arcane Surge while you already have the buff will refresh its duration.

Stats that state "{{c|mod|Arcane Surge also grants...}}", such as {{psl|Hypnotic Gaze of the Lich}} (20% mana [[recoup]] and 20% increased mana [[cost]] efficiency), [[Hierophant]]'s {{psl|Arcane Blessing}} (20% more [[spell damage]]), or {{il|Runegraft of Resurgence}} (15% increased life regeneration rate) modify the buff itself; accordingly, these effects are also scaled by modifiers to Arcane Surge effect.

===Unique items===
Some unique items grants the buff upon fulfil some conditions:

{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=items.stat_text LIKE "%Gain%Arcane_Surge%" OR items.stat_text LIKE "%Grant%Arcane_Surge%" OR items.stat_text LIKE "%Supported%Arcane_Surge%" OR items.name = "Forbidden Shako"
|base_item=1
|large=1
|level=1
|stat=1
}}

==Version history==
Prior to [[version 3.26.0]], {{il|Arcane Surge Support}}'s Arcane Surge buff scaled with gem level and took priority over other sources of Arcane Surge.

{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.26.0|
* The Arcane Surge Buff now provides 20% increased Cast Speed (previously 10%).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.21.0|
* Arcane Surge buff now grants 10% increased Cast Speed instead of 10% more Spell Damage.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.15.0|
* Arcane Surge buff no longer grants 10% increased Cast Speed.
* Arcane Surge buff now grants 30% increased Mana Regeneration Rate (previously 0.5% of Mana Regenerated per second).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.4.0|
* Added a new buff icon for Arcane Surge.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.0.0|
* Introduced to the game.
}}
{{Version history table end}}
